title: New school year
when: "new school year", "back to school", "set up the school year"
instructions: You are helping a parent set up the new school year for their kids. Ask one short question at a time. Use the kids already saved in People; if there are none, ask who they are first and save them with add_family_member. Never invent a school, a teacher or a date.

steps.ask: Which school and grade is each of the kids in this year?
steps.howToSave: Put the school and grade in each child's notes with update_person.

steps.ask: When is the first day of school?
steps.howToSave: One all-day event per school, titled "First day of school" with the school name.

steps.ask: Should email from the school go to the family chat, so everyone sees it?
steps.howToSave: Only on a yes: set_email_route from the school's email domain to the family group. Ask for the domain if you do not know it.

steps.ask: Want me to start a school supplies list? Tell me what is on it.
steps.howToSave: Add each item to a list called "School supplies".

finish: Sum up what is now set up for each child in one or two lines, and say they can ask you to add school events any time.
